As Lead Full Stack Developer, you take a key role in the further development and evolution of a suite of business-critical applications used in real-time operational environments.
You remain strongly hands-on in both backend and frontend development, working primarily with .NET and Angular, while also guiding technical choices, improving existing implementations and helping shape upcoming solutions. You challenge current approaches where needed and translate complex technical topics into clear and pragmatic proposals.
A major part of the role is technical leadership. You support and coach other developers, promote knowledge sharing and help maintain high standards in code quality, maintainability and software design. You work closely with analysts, architects, testers and other developers within an Agile/Scrum setup.
You also keep a close eye on delivery, scope and technical risks. When dependencies, architectural concerns or implementation issues arise, you identify them early and help the team move towards a robust and sustainable solution.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT (or equivalent through strong experience)
• Senior professional experience in .NET & Angular
• +15 years of experience in IT
• You're a pragmatic team player

Are you a financial expert and does accounting have no secrets for you? Do you like studying figures and do you like to have ownership? Then the position of Accounting Specialist at Miele Belux is your next career step! In this position, you are the pivot between the financial processes, the people and the resulting administration. Together with the controllers, shared service centre and external parties, such as our accountants and advisors, you ensure accurate accounting. This not only involves the correct administration of the figures, but also identifying bottlenecks and risks in terms of legislation and regulations. You will be working in a multinational team, with a manager who focuses on your talents and prepares you for a great career within Miele. The many international contacts within the Miele group offer you the opportunity to build an interesting network.
 

What you will be doing:
 

The Accounting Specialist plays a vital role in maintaining the financial integrity of the organization by ensuring accurate financial record-keeping, timely processing of transactions, and compliance with group financial policies and local regulatory requirements. The role supports effective financial management through attention to detail, strong analytical skills, and a commitment to excellence. You are the first point of contact within the Belgium affiliate and the right hand of the Accounting Manager covering the cluster of Belgium/Luxembourg/Netherlands/France.
 

Key Responsibilities:
 
 

• Support month-end and year-end closing activities for the Belgian entity in collaboration with our global shared services (MGS) teams in Poland. 

• Ensure accurate bookings, accruals, reconciliations, and allocations to cost and profit centers. 

• Be a key point of contact for external and internal audit matters. 

• Support tax and legal compliance processes, including VAT, and other statutory declarations. 

• Evaluate internal systems, controls, and risks, and provide recommendations for improvement. 

• Contribute to Belgian and global process optimization projects. 

• Support the FP&A team with financial transparency, reporting, and follow-up.  

 

The Accounting Specialist we are looking for:
 

We are looking for someone who is structured, accountable, and principled, with a strong sense of ownership for financial integrity and operational follow-through. You enjoy working with both numbers and practical coordination, and you are comfortable communicating with internal stakeholders as well as external service partners.
 
 

• Bachelor’s degree in finance or accounting, economics, business administration. 

• +8 years of experience in a similar role. 

• A strong accounting foundation, with proven experience in closing periods, balance sheet ownership, statutory and tax reporting. 

• Handles sensitive financial information with the highest level of confidentiality, integrity, and accountability while adhering to professional and organizational standards. 

• Communicates financial information clearly and professionally to colleagues, management, auditors, and other stakeholders. 

• A proactive, detail-oriented approach with a passion for continuous improvement and eagerness to take ownership, contribute to harmonization of processes across the region. 

• Works collaboratively across departments and builds positive relationships. 

• Able to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines. 

• Experience in a multinational, multi-location matrix environment.. 

• Experience working with SAP is an advantage, proficiency in Excel. 

• Excellent communication skills in English and Dutch/French, both written and verbal.

As a Bus Diagnostic Technician, you’ll help lead the transition to smart, electric passenger transport. You’ll work in a modern workshop where you track down, analyze, and solve technical faults on buses from various brands. From day one, you play a crucial role in getting our vehicles back on the road quickly and safely.

On a typical workday, you analyze malfunctions using diagnostic equipment, read error codes, and interpret electrical diagrams. You carry out mechanical, electrical, and electronic repairs and maintain precise work administration. You support colleagues with complex problems, assist with roadside service during working hours, and continue to learn about new technologies such as electric drive systems.

Are you ready to further develop your technical expertise in a rapidly evolving sector? Apply today and discover a varied job where quality, teamwork, and innovation are key!

• Degree in automotive engineering, electromechanics, or equivalent through experience

• At least 2 years of experience as a diagnostic, bus, or truck technician

• Strong knowledge of mechanics, electricity, and electronics

• Experience with diagnostic equipment

• Valid driver's license B (D is a plus)

• Good command of Dutch or English

• Accurate, quality-oriented, and a real team player

• Experience with electric vehicles or an HEV2 certificate is a plus, but not required

• Technical mindset and eagerness to learn are essential

• Willingness for occasional roadside service during or outside working hours

• Service vehicle for business and private use (after 6 months)

What is a Business Analyst in insurance domain at cream?

As Stella, Business Analyst (in Insurance Domain), embrace your role and support the different applications in the insurance industry (life and non life). You will be the liaison among business and IT teams.
Your tasks

• Participate and lead requirements gathering sessions with clients

• Produce Functional Design and Requirements Specification documents on domains of expertise e.g. New Business, Claims, etc.

• Implement, in means of configuration, relevant aspects of the client's requirements

• Write/ Review test plans

• Perform expert testing and defect management following development/configuration

• Conduct training sessions on the system and its configured product set

• Production support including UAT testing, defect analysis and Change Requests management

• Perform gap analysis

• You have a Master degree or equivalent experience

• Minimum 5 years of experience: ideally 3 or more years of experience within an insurance company

• You have proven experience as a Business Analyst

• You can meet project deadlines and provide high-quality deliverables

• You have a cultural openness and adaptability, you are rigorous, customer-oriented and you have high communications skills and analytical skills

• You are able to work with autonomy while being also a great team player

• You are fluent in French and a good command of English, Dutch is a plus

• You are committed to travelling abroad occasionally upon the client's request

jobs.occupation: Cream Consulting by Audensiel - Scrum Master
jobs.description:
What is cream all about?

We could be a Cream Factory, a cooking blog or even a detective agency...

But in reality, we are a Business & Technology consulting company, active in large organizations and industry leaders in Banking, Insurance, Telecom, Energy, & Transport.

The Cream recipe

- 1/3 Personal development - 1/3 Collective intelligence - 1/3 Intrapreneurship - Bonus ingredient: some passionate colleagues
Your future projects

Like Mael, a Scrum Master at Cream, embrace your role and be involved in a large-scale IT project. Your tasks will be:

• You guarantee a smooth use of the Scrum methodology

• You are responsible for delivering and achieving the goals of the project

• You organise and facilitate all the Scrum ceremonies: the daily Scrum, the sprint planning, the retrospective meetings

• You manage the different risks of the project and remove barriers (manage interdependencies & Impediments)

• You provide assistance or support to the Product Owner concerning the Product Backlog

• You can challenge yourself in contact with technical and business teams

What do we expect from our Consultant?

• You have between 1 to 5 years of experience as a Scrum Master

• You have a good knowledge of agile methodologies. A certification is an asset.

• You have strong communication, listening & relational skills

• You are fluent in French, Dutch and English

-

As Louis, Product Owner, embrace your role and be part of an Agile team from one of our clients. You will be responsible for the successful outcome of the client project by following an Agile methodology. Your goal is to maximize the value of the product/project.
Your tasks 

• Manage and plan the Sprint in collaboration with the Scrum Master

• Manage and define the Product Backlog and prioritize the different elements and goals

• Make sure that the Product Backlog is visible and comprehensive for everyone

• Coordinate the team and maintain in order the backlog

• Write the user stories

• Optimize the work of the team

• Challenge yourself in contact with technical and business teams

What do WE expect from our Consultant ?

• You have at least 2 years of experience as a Product Owner

• You have a good knowledge of the Agile methodologies

• You have good organizational and communicational skills

• You are fluent in French or Dutch (Bonus: with good knowledge of the other one) and English

-

Within the Infrastructure and Security practice, together with Marie, embrace your role and be responsible for the operation, monitoring, improvement, and development of the IAM processes and tools.

Our technological architecture must run alongside and support our business goals at Sopra Steria, and IT Architects make that happen by creating blueprints for software, hardware, networks, and data systems. Security and efficiency are safeguarded as IT Architects conduct risk assessments and ensure regulatory compliance. As an IT Architect, you’ll take the long view with a strategic planning mindset, deep technical knowledge, and strong problem-solving skills. Scalability as we work towards digital transformation is crucial, as we collaborate with stakeholders to adopt new technologies. 

Our Architects have the vision and leadership skills to make daring IT decisions that can make digital transformation a reality. Your ability to collaborate across teams and departments and your flexibility to adopt new technologies will help you enhance system performance, scalability, and security. Fulfil your software vision at Sopra Steria and align it with our business development goals. As a Sopra Steria Architect, you’ll have successful projects in your portfolio that can demonstrate your excellent problemsolving skills and commitment to continuous learning. 

 

Your profile

We’re seeking passionate colleagues who are eager to push the boundaries in digital transformation and technology consulting. At Sopra Steria, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills in a constructive, collaborative team environment, working on impactful projects that drive change for our clients. If you thrive on challenge and meet (most of) the qualifications below, we look forward to your application! You have knowledge and experience of the following:

• Fullstack .NET development
• Git
• Docker
• Azure
• Kubernetes
• Event-driven
• N-tier
• Onion architecture
• Coaching people
• Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a relevant equivalent 
• 
Languages: English and Dutch or French

As a fullstack developer, you’ll play a key role in developing tailor-made applications for a diverse range of clients. Supported by a software architect and an experienced team of developers, you’ll be involved in every stage of the development cycle: design, development, implementation, and documentation.

The company stands out with a flat organizational structure, where your contributions are truly recognized. You’ll join a team where knowledge sharing and teamwork are central, with plenty of room for autonomy as well.

 

Responsibilities:

You are responsible for the entire application development process; together with your colleagues you build the perfect solution for the customer. 

To do so, you are assisted by a softwarearchitect with whom you determine the optimal architecture. From there, you take up your responsibility in the development cycle: from development and design to implementation and documentation. 

Thanks to our flat hierarchy your contribution to the result is always visible. You will join a team of other .Net developers in which knowledge sharing and teamwork are basic elements. 

However, independence is also required from time to time. The team is responsible for the complete implementation of projects: from the start-up and configuration to the final delivery.

Furthermore, they work on our newest E-trade products each day. Both products have an annual release program and road map in which you are an important link.

 

Your Profile : 

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science (or equivalent experience).
• Technical skills:
• Strong experience with C#, ASP.NET, and .NET Core.
• Knowledge of Entity Framework, microservices, Kubernetes, RabbitMQ, or Xamarin is a plus.
• Languages: Proficiency in Dutch and English, both written and spoken.
• Flexibility: Willingness to travel occasionally for short trips abroad.
• 
Personality: You are customer-focused, eager to learn, open-minded, and a strong team player. A sense of humor is always a bonus!

Experience in building applications for web, mobile, desktop, or gaming? You’ll be familiar with .NET by Microsoft. This open-source, cross-platform framework (compatible with macOS, Windows, and Linux) supports various programming languages, including the ever-popular C#. Thanks to its high-performance runtime, consistent programming model, and extensive library of precoded solutions .NET enables us to incorporate performance, security, reliability, and productivity into our solutions. 

Our Developers specialise in application and software development while seamlessly integrating systems, so we never lose sight of our business goals. With an eye towards user experience and productivity, you’ll design, code, and test new functionalities while troubleshooting issues, optimizing performance, and keeping technical documentation in order. Our developers love to design and are always informed of the latest design trends. When fulfilling day-to-day tasks, you’ll always be ready with a solution when there’s a problem. You’ll also collaborate with other teams and never miss a detail so you can deliver solutions that meet Sopra Steria’s quality standards. 

 

We’re seeking passionate colleagues who are eager to push the boundaries in digital transformation and technology consulting. At Sopra Steria, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills in a constructive, collaborative team environment, working on impactful projects that drive change for our clients. If you thrive on challenge and meet (most of) the qualifications below, we look forward to your application! 

• .NET
• Angular
• Mobile and web development
• Entity Framework
• UWP
• WCF
• API design
• Design patterns
• DevOps
• OO principles 
• Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a relevant equivalent 
• Languages: English, and Dutch or French required
